sections.heading: 0.1.0-alpha.47
paragraphs: A major update since alpha.38: conversational reminders, a notification inbox, Room state, token statistics and the Warm Linen light theme.

The exact public alpha.38 package supports a manual installer run in the existing folder, without removing the app or Home. V031 → V039 memory migration is a separate, confirmed operation with verified local snapshots.

This is a test alpha, not a stable release: full end-to-end acceptance of this exact alpha.47 has been deferred. Local package checks and a signed HTTPS test download do not replace installed acceptance.
Alpha.39–46 were not separate public releases. These notes collect development and QA changes since alpha.38. The app remains free; cloud requests are billed through your own API key.

sections.heading: Checks that the bytes match. It does not replace a publisher’s digital signature.
paragraphs: No Windows publisher signature.

sections.heading: Alpha
paragraphs: Updates are checked automatically; download and installation require confirmation.

sections.heading: Added
paragraphs: Time and event awareness: system time zone, relative dates and reminders that the AI proposes to create, find, reschedule or cancel based on meaning, without keyword-triggered actions.

One-time reminders as ordinary Miggi messages in their Room, with creation confirmation and notice of a future API request. Dates without a time default to 09:00; explicit nighttime requests are allowed. Overdue reminders are checked when the app returns.

A bell with shared notification history, unread preview, navigation to the original message and individual or mark-all-read controls. A notification visible in the active chat is marked read after 1.5 seconds.
Room state: current decisions, constraints, open questions and next steps linked to source messages. Updated with the reply; closed entries and long sources can be retrieved on request.
A separate token-statistics window for the day, week and month, with optional model breakdown. Estimated costs remain in the website calculator.
An in-app capability guide separate from Miggi’s identity and origin; official GitHub guides and news are read with permission and treated as reference material.
The Warm Linen light theme, a busy indicator when switching themes in settings, and distinct visual treatments for your messages and Miggi’s replies.
A refined Miggi identity: an ancient spirit of fire, hope and dreams. Replies and reminder wording share one personality source; the full description is loaded on request.
Startup pre-rendering of UI and animations, a fixed lower chat toggle beside Miggi, external zoom controls hidden until hover, and Ctrl+/Ctrl− shortcuts.
Installer and updater infrastructure for explicitly confirmed memory-format transitions. This supports future verified releases, not an automatic alpha.38 → alpha.47 update.

sections.heading: Fixed
paragraphs: Optimised Brain request schemas, phase-specific instructions and bounded evidence retrieval to reduce technical overhead without deleting canonical history or identity.
Improved reminder-memory continuity across Rooms: saving, displaying, reading and completing a task are distinct facts. Historical records without display evidence remain unknown.
Reminder confirmations leave one final result instead of a chain of service messages, and use your selected text scale.
Tool, file-study and memory permissions and reminders share rounded orange frames in chat and bubbles; spacing, duplicate headings and button labels are corrected.
Fixed lost input and scrolling after notification navigation, unread-badge updates and history jumps after confirmations.
Improved the first chat opening, window transitions and the composer seam; shortened tooltips, warmed up resources and made theme changes more responsive.
Fixed long-message reads and Room-state continuation against a stale source window; clarified context-compaction diagnostic states.

Core asks Windows for a free local port instead of choosing randomly; startup diagnostics preserve the phase and safe error codes. Update-window responses and the compact memory-migration confirmation are improved.

sections.heading: Known limitations
paragraphs: The EXE has no Windows Authenticode signature. Do not bypass SmartScreen or Smart App Control or disable Windows protection; TUF is not a Windows publisher signature.

The first move from exact alpha.38 is manual, not through its old updater. Other old and test builds need a separate compatibility check. The signed baseline describes only alpha.47; future updates need a prepared exact-source release.

Fresh installation, installed alpha.38 → alpha.47 and the full signed GUI update with deferred migration have not been tested on this exact alpha.47. Historical alpha.44–46 checks are not acceptance of this file.

Keep an independent copy of important data before migration. Local database snapshots exclude Home files and Windows keys and are not a portable backup. Do not open V039 with an older app or delete protected records to bypass a refusal.

Experimental encrypted backups and the recovery utility are disabled. The persistent visual House and a portable full-Home backup are not implemented; the ordinary database is not encrypted in full by the app.
Technical minimum: Windows 10 x86_64 build 17763. The full Windows/GPU/DPI matrix and all long-session behaviour remain unverified. Available tools depend on the selected AI connection.
